items.title: When should we bring Northstar in?
items.description: When you have a growth question worth answering: a new channel to assess, a program to improve, or a partnership model to build with more discipline.

items.title: Do you work with in-house teams?
items.description: Yes. We often complement in-house marketing, commercial, and analytics teams with channel expertise, structured experimentation, and an outside view.

items.title: How do you report on the work?
items.description: We agree on the decisions that reporting needs to support, then share a direct view of activity, learning, and the next recommended action.

items.title: Can publishers apply to partner with you?
items.description: Absolutely. We welcome publishers who value quality offers, respectful communication, and a long-term approach to audience trust.
